resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and firelookout.com give 45 ft for the 1933 tower. The Oregon page gives 55 ft in its 1933 entry and quotes a 1933 newspaper giving 60 ft. The brief's 16.8 m (55 ft) follows only the Oregon page, so height_m is left out of facts until someone checks the 1933 record.
1933 in the register, firelookout.com and the Oregon page. A 1958 newspaper says the replaced tower was erected in 1934.
The brief says Blue Ridge and Blue Rock share a register number. The detail pages and the Oregon list give US 765 for Blue Ridge and US 766 for Blue Rock, so they do not share one.

firelookout.com and the Oregon page put the site 8 to 10 miles southeast of Coos Bay. The register's detail coordinates (43.163040, -123.885350) differ from the list coordinates the brief uses (43.2711, -124.08647). Not resolved here.

notes_for_editor: Built 1933, abandoned 1966 and dismantled 1974 are supported by several sources. Height and build year conflict and are left out of facts. Coordinates conflict between the register detail page and the list; the list values from the brief were kept but not checked on a map. The 1942 survey marker is the only description of the site; whether it survives is not stated. Staffing names come from 1935-1945 newspaper items quoted on the Oregon page; originals not read. Photos on the register page are credited to a private collection and were not added.
